means: A tool call whose long arguments sit in the output store under a handle; the log keeps {ref, name, want} and an argument summary.
What a held tool call's card and wh held show: the tool name and its arguments, resolved from the handle for a stored call.

name: held call shows what it will do
claim: A held tool call whose arguments are stored by handle shows the operator those arguments, in the page's held card and in wh held, while the model is sent exactly what it was sent before.

name: stored call keeps its argument summary
claim: Every call whose arguments are stored by handle has its argument summary beside the message, so the turn profile lists its path and the sizes of its content, never only the handle.

name: held call shows what it will do
claim: A held tool call whose arguments are stored by handle shows the operator those arguments, in the page held card and in wh held, while the model is sent exactly what it was sent before.

models.result: browser suite red 5 of 268 then green 268 of 268; wh suite red 2 of 34 then green 34 of 34; held file_edit of 1600 chars and a repeat by handle show the path and whole text; request body after a held step equals the one without a hold; bare-handle card was not reproduced in the page

name: stored call keeps its argument summary
claim: Every call whose arguments are stored by handle has its argument summary beside the message, so the turn profile lists its path and the sizes of its content, never only the handle.

models.result: a call the model repeated by handle ({"ref": ...}) was never swapped and had no summary; now the harness keeps it and profile() reuses the earlier summary of the same tool and handle; profile suite red 1 of 38 then green 38 of 38; browser suite checks the path for 3 file_edit calls

fault: a call a model repeated by its handle was short, so it was never swapped and kept no argument summary; the turn profile and the held step showed only the handle
handled: the harness keeps the summary of what the handle holds; profile() gives a handle-alone call the summary of the earlier call of the same tool and handle; the held card and wh show the tool and the summary (860f8ae)
